chunks.title: Constellations School IT Support Knowledge Base
chunks.content:
Account Lockout Policy
Accounts may be temporarily locked after repeated failed login attempts.
Students: Wait 15 minutes before retrying
Staff: Contact IT immediately if access is needed for instruction
If lockout persists after 15 minutes:
IT must manually unlock the account
Repeated lockouts may indicate:
Incorrect saved password on device
Possible unauthorized access attempt

Common Issues & Fixes
Not receiving MFA code:
Check cellular signal or Wi-Fi
Verify correct phone number is registered
Open authenticator app manually
Changed or lost phone:
IT must reset MFA enrollment
User must re-register device
Authenticator app issues:
Ensure device time is synced automatically
Try backup verification method
